description: cyclestreets is an R package that connects to CycleStreets routing and cycling-data APIs. Its README describes it as a modular interface split from stplanr, with installation and example requests. Users submit locations or route queries; outputs are cycle route and associated network information from the upstream service for the chosen area. Geographic coverage follows CycleStreets service coverage, chiefly the UK. GitHub metadata states GPL-3.0 licensing for the R client. A limitation is that route quality and API availability depend on the upstream service and its data terms, which are separate from this code licence. Suggested cycling routes are not observed cyclist volumes or safety outcomes. The client can supply route alternatives for active-mobility accessibility or network simulations. The related catalogue AequilibraE record is a separate transport modelling package. No API output or R package was downloaded.
name: CycleStreets R routing API client
